marks.gloss_en: the sun, only one of the servants before the Holy One, you cannot look at; the Shechina, all the more so
[facing the sun in the season of Tammuz] the emperor: I cannot [look at it]
trees, whose way is not to come out mixed, were told 'after its kind'; we, whose way is to come out mixed, all the more so
the grasses: if the Holy One's will were a mixture, why did He say 'after its kind' of the trees?
דכתיב המקרה במים עליותיו -- her own verse for 'your God is a carpenter'
the emperor's daughter: your God is a carpenter
שנאמר משור פר מקרין מפריס -- Rav Yehuda's own verse
מקרין תרתי משמע -- 'makrin' implies two horns
מקרן כתיב -- it is written [defectively] makran, one horn
Rav Yehuda: the ox that Adam the first man offered had one horn on its forehead
מקרין ברישא והדר מפריס -- Rav Yehuda's own verse, read for its word order
Rav Yehuda: the ox that Adam the first man offered -- its horns preceded its hooves
מסייע ליה לרבי יהושע בן לוי -- Rav Yehuda's horns-before-hooves supports RYbL's 'all the works of creation were created in their stature'
שנאמר וכל צבאם -- אל תקרי צבאם אלא צביונם; offered for the whole statement, attached to the clause it reads
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: all the works of creation were created in their [full] stature
R' Yehoshua ben Chananya: you cannot [make a meal for Him] -- why? His hosts are many
he toiled six summer months and a wind swept it into the sea; he toiled six winter months and rain sank it in the sea
the emperor's daughter: tell your God to take back what He gave me
Rav Yehuda: the ox is large-bellied and large-hooved, large of head and large of tail
R' Chanina bar Pappa: 'may the glory of the Lord endure forever; let the Lord rejoice in His works' (Ps 104:31) -- this verse the minister of the world said
immediately each and every one came out after its kind, and the minister of the world opened and said: 'may the glory of the Lord endure forever; let the Lord rejoice in His works'
Ravina: one who grafted two grasses one on the other -- according to R' Chanina bar Pappa, what [is he liable]?
